I've added a blog to this site as a place to write — short notes on research I'm
reading, ideas from the lab, thoughts on language, cognition, and AI, and the
occasional aside about everything else.

Nothing fancy to start. More soon.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## How I add a new post (note to self)

Create a folder under `blog/` (for example `blog/my-post/`) with an `index.qmd`
inside. Give it a `title`, a `date`, an optional `description`, and one or more
`categories`. Re-render the site and it shows up here automatically, newest first.
:::
